_meta.nota: English. Ninguna frase fue revisada por hablantes. El español es la referencia.

claves.simulacion_ayuda: Opens TerraLab 3D in another tab: prepare plots and try rotations in 3D.
claves.pie: Regional data, not a measurement of your plot. It does not estimate harvest, money or erosion.
claves.hero_texto: Compare rotations with NASA POWER climate history. The decision is still yours.
claves.desc_clima: The climate's past, in context for your next decision.
claves.desc_suelo: Follow the soil cover of each rotation through the year.
claves.desc_ficha: The evidence for your scenario, ready to read, take with you and listen to.
claves.aviso_ia: AI machine translation: it may contain errors and has not yet been reviewed by speakers. Figures, sources and approved messages stay in Spanish, which is the reference.
claves.aviso_otro: To read in another language, use your browser's “Translate” option (in Chrome: right-click → Translate). It is machine translation: Spanish is the reference.

textos.Obrajes y alrededores, Oruro (celda regi: Obrajes and surroundings, Oruro (regional cell of ~50 km)
textos.Raíz no pronostica: muestra señales de l: Raíz does not forecast: it shows signals in the data and cites the dated NOAA forecast.
Synthetic voice (Meta MMS, CC BY-NC 4.0). Needs peer review before it is shared.
textos.. Cada ventana abarca tres campañas cons: . Each window spans three consecutive seasons; windows can overlap and are not independent.
textos.No aplica o falta el dato: Does not apply or data missing
textos.Indicadores separados de la campaña de d: Indicators separate from the decision season. Less water demand does not mean more production; Raíz does not estimate harvest or money.
textos.Ciclo de tres campañas históricas: decis: Cycle of three historical seasons: the decision and the two following, with their real climate
textos.Descanso en la campaña de decisión: el i: Fallow in the decision season: the crop indicator does not apply
textos.Raíz compara escenarios históricos. Los: Raíz compares historical scenarios. The indicators are simulations on regional climate; they are not a forecast or a measurement of your field.
textos.Evaluación histórica simulada; no es pro: Simulated historical evaluation; not a forecast or a plot observation
textos.No cuantifica rendimiento, ingresos ni e: It does not quantify yield, income or erosion in tonnes
textos.Granizo: es la segunda causa de pérdida: Hail: the second cause of loss according to the farmer, and it CANNOT be modelled with NASA POWER (P6-1)
textos.Los umbrales de helada son de temperatur: Frost thresholds refer to plant temperature; POWER gives air at 2 m in a ~50 km cell
textos.El productor riega papa y haba con pozo:: The farmer irrigates potato and broad bean from a well: the net irrigation required shows the pressure on the well in dry years
textos.Elige el tamaño que te resulte más cómod: Choose the size that is most comfortable for you. It changes the text on every screen and is saved in this browser.
Usual size for reading and comparing.
Gentle entrances and decorative motion. If your device asks for reduced motion, we respect that preference.
textos.¿Cómo fue el clima antes y cómo es ahora: What was the climate like before, and what is it like now in Oruro?
textos.Campañas de noviembre a marzo. Dato regi: Seasons from November to March. Regional NASA data, not a forecast.
textos.entre campañas). No es tendencia ni caus: between seasons). It is not a trend or a cause.
textos.Campañas por tipo de año (ONI de NOAA): Seasons by type of year (NOAA ONI)
textos.Cuántas campañas hubo de cada tipo (n): How many seasons of each type there were (n)
textos.Borde grueso: años del escenario elegido: Thick border: years of the chosen scenario. ENSO classifies only the first year; not every El Niño year was dry.
textos.¿Cuándo queda el suelo sin protección?: When is the soil left unprotected?
textos.Días de suelo desnudo con lluvia o vient: Days of bare soil with heavy rain or strong wind. It does not measure erosion.
textos.Calendario supuesto; no es una observaci: Assumed calendar; not a satellite observation.
textos.Suelo descubierto con lluvia y viento: Uncovered soil with rain and wind
textos.El catálogo no define umbrales del semáf: The catalogue does not define traffic-light thresholds (P6). Only the counts are shown, without colour.
textos.Sensibilidad y calidad de la evidencia: Sensitivity and quality of the evidence
textos.Cobertura del suelo mes a mes, de agosto: Soil cover month by month, from August to July
textos.Ficha para llevar, imprimir o escuchar: Sheet to take, print or listen to
textos.Secano: sin riego (situación más común e: Rainfed: no irrigation (most common situation in Oruro)
textos.Estos datos son de toda la zona (unos 50: These data are for the whole area (about 50 km), not your field. Compare them with what you see on your plot.
textos.El granizo no se puede medir con estos d: Hail cannot be measured with these data. If it often hails in your area, take it into account separately.
textos.El suelo no fue medido: usamos un valor: The soil was not measured: we use a typical value for "sandy clay loam" soil, as a farmer from Obrajes described it.
textos.Raíz no le dice qué sembrar. Le muestra: Raíz does not tell you what to plant. It shows how these options did in past years. The decision is yours and your technician's.
textos.No pudimos comparar con una segunda fuen: We could not compare with a second rainfall source. This result uses NASA data (POWER) only.
textos.No es predicción ni orden de siembra. No: It is not a prediction or a planting order. It does not estimate harvest, money or erosion.
textos.Dato regional NASA, no de la finca. Deci: Regional NASA data, not from the farm. The farmer decides.
textos.Guion aprobado por P5/P6 (acta P5-2); pr: Script approved by P5/P6 (record P5-2); prepared for radio, not broadcast
textos.Quechua (voz de un productor de Obrajes): Quechua (voice of a farmer from Obrajes)
textos.Estamos leyendo los datos históricos y s: We are reading the historical data and its sources.
textos.No pudimos cargar los datos: We could not load the data
Net water the crop would lack. 1 mm = 10 m³ per hectare.
textos.Días en que el cultivo sufre por poca hu: Days when the crop suffers from low soil moisture.
textos.Parte del año con plantas o rastrojo pro: Share of the year with plants or residue protecting the soil (according to the calendar).
textos.Días en que el suelo está descubierto y: Days when the soil is uncovered and rain exceeds the threshold. It is a count, not tonnes of erosion.
Days when the soil is uncovered and wind exceeds the threshold.
textos.Días con temperatura mínima bajo el umbr: Days with minimum temperature below the declared flowering threshold. Regional data, not frost measured in your field.
textos.Lo que se podría aplicar sin pasar el lí: What could be applied without exceeding the chosen water limit.
textos.Está dentro de la zona de los datos: est: It is inside the data area: these results work as a regional reference for you.
textos.Está lejos de la zona de los datos: los: It is far from the data area: the results are for Obrajes and may not resemble your plot.
textos.Elige tu parcela en la simulación 3D y a: Choose your plot in the 3D simulation and you will see the water in cubic metres for your land here.

patrones.En tu parcela, 1 mm de riego son {n} m³: On your plot, 1 mm of irrigation is {n} m³ of water.
